item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP537 – Sell More Books On Amazon – with Janet Margot
item.description: Janet doesn't just understand the Amazon Ads platform—she helped build it. During her ten-year tenure at Amazon, she owned the advertiser experience for books and spearheaded its international expansion. Today, Janet leads Book Geeks Media, where she translates elite tech algorithms into actionable growth for independent authors.

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP538 – Easy Networking For Authors – with Celeste Barclay (Classic Replay)
item.description: A lot of us are introverts and the idea of "networking" gives us chills (and not in a good way). Historical Romance author, Celeste Barclay, recorded this show with us a few years ago. Her advice is just as relevant now, as building your author community will help ride out the ups and downs of this wild self-publishing ride!

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP539 – The Inflexion Point for Authors with Nicholas Erik (Part One)
item.description: Nicholas Erik joins us again with fantastic insight into the impact technology is having on the publishing world — right down to us as individual authors. Now this isn't a pro or anti AI episode — it's about understanding how we as authors can adapt to these technology shifts, overcome our pain points through technology, and how the companies we're dealing with on a day-to-day basis are utilizing it.

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP540 – The Inflexion Point with Nicholas Erik (Part Two)
item.description: Part Two of our interview with Nicholas Erik where we discuss the future of AI and publishing and how authors can choose to use, or not use, new technology tools.

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP541 – Interview with Kaye Kennedy: Launch To Success
item.description: Well worth a re-listen, this episode was originally recorded a few years ago when romance and romantic suspense author, Kaye Kennedy, scaled her author business from zero to a million page reads in just six months. Kaye utilized her business skills to launch in a focussed way that was truly inspiring (then and now).

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP542 – Using AI Assistance for Authors – with Alessandra Torre
item.description: AI is a hot discussion point in the author community these days, and we're joined again by bestselling author and educator, Alessandra Torre, to help us unpack this topic. At the outset, we acknowledge that this is a difficult topic to cover. From feeling fear to excitement and everything in between, authors cannot deny the reality of the new technologies arriving (and the "new language" around it which can be confusing.)

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP543 – Use Brain Science to Hook Readers From the Very First Sentence with Lisa Cron (Classic Replay)
item.description: Want to hook your readers from the very first sentence? This episode is for you!

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP544 – 5 Tips To Harness Trends
item.description: From incorporating popular tropes to social media trends, the SPA Girls have a robust discussion around what they're doing to harness trends to reach more readers and sell more books!

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP545 – Six Figures Writing Short Romance with Sadie King (Classic Replay)
item.description: USA Today Bestseller, Sadie King has grown her publishing business from zero to six figures in less than four years, writing short instalove romances. Knowing her reader’s journey is vital to her success.

item.title: SPA Girls Podcast – EP546 – Interview with Lucy Score: Breaking Out, Advice For New Authors
item.description: In this episode, Lucy talks about what her breakout moment actually looked like from the inside, how she's navigated the shift from working author to household name (and instant #1 NYT Bestseller), and what's stayed surprisingly the same. We dig into the practical stuff , including her evolving covers, brand-building, the Riley Thorn series, and advice for emerging authors. Plus the mindset it takes to keep showing up at the page when the pressure (and the audience) keeps growing.
